history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take expeditious action to amend and promulgate the Secretary- General’s bulletins to specify and enhance the clarity of the roles and responsibilities of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support.
history.administration_response: While the dual structure is well established without them, the Secretary-General’s bulletins on both the Department of Operational Support and the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance are nearing completion. Specifically, the drafts considered to be final by the Departments are now undergoing consultation with all Secretariat entities, with a deadline of 1 March. Thereafter, the two Departments will consider any needed amendments to the drafts, after which the Office of Legal Affairs will conduct its review before the drafts are sent to the Secretary-General for promulgation.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Secretary-General’s bulletins were still in processing and have not been formally issued, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration take expeditious action to amend and promulgate the Secretary-General’s bulletins to specify and enhance the clarity of the roles and responsibilities of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support.
history.administration_response: The Administration requests that the Board consider this recommendation to be overtaken by events. The Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support have been operating without a Secretary-General’s bulletin for more than six years. The mandate, functions and organization of both Departments have been set out in budget documents – approved by the General Assembly – over multiple budget cycles since the recommendation was made. Given the requirements of the policy promulgation process and the existence of other urgent priorities, the Administration requests that this recommendation be closed, because there is a need to focus resources on more urgent matters.
history.board_assessment: Given that the mandate, functions and organization of the Department of Management Strategy, Policy and Compliance and the Department of Operational Support have been set out in budget documents – approved by the General Assembly – over multiple budget cycles, the Board considers the recommendation to be overtaken by events.
